_readme: One iconic voice line per champion, for the Quote puzzle.
Coverage is deliberately partial. There is no programmatic source for champion
voice lines anywhere — CommunityDragon serves VO as audio with no transcript,
and the Fandom wiki blocks fetching — so every line here is hand-entered, and
only lines we are confident are real were entered. A half-remembered quote is
worse than no quote: it makes an unanswerable puzzle.
puzzleService.poolFor() deals the Quote mode only from champions that appear
here, so adding a champion widens the pool and omitting one costs nothing.

Anivia: The cycle of life and death continues.
Annie: Come play with me and Tibbers!
Braum: The heart is the strongest muscle!
Caitlyn: It's time to bring peace to Piltover.
Draven: Welcome to the League of Draven!
Graves: Everybody, keep your hands where I can see 'em.
Jax: Imagine if I had a real weapon!
Jayce: The future is in good hands. Mine.
Jinx: Rules are made to be broken... like buildings! Or people!
Lucian: I'll do what needs to be done.
Mordekaiser: The living are such fragile things.
Nasus: The cycle of life and death continues... for you.
Renekton: The butcher of the sands has come for you.
Riven: What is broken can be reforged!
Shen: The unseen blade is the deadliest.
Sylas: Chains were meant to be broken.
Veigar: Tiny in stature, huge in power!
XinZhao: Death is no excuse for poor manners.
Yasuo: Death is like the wind — always by my side.
